makeup.name: Cocoa-Caramel Warm Browns
makeup.summary: The monochrome coffee face is becoming a standing color system.
makeup.description: Cappuccino, caramel, cocoa and espresso tones are moving across lids, cheeks and lips in one family, finished with a wet-look highlight so the warmth reads bright rather than heavy.

signals.note: Ten autumn cocoa looks released together
#lattemakeup total views
#espressomakeup total views

makeup.action: Build a coordinated cream bronzer, liquid blush, eye color and lip gloss drop. Keep a glossy highlight step in the system so the monochrome result remains dimensional and camera-ready.

makeup.name: Black Cherry and Deep Berry
makeup.summary: Cool-toned dark lips are returning in blurred and high-shine finishes.
makeup.description: Deep wine, black cherry and crushed berry are replacing the summer nude. Soft edges and cool undertones make the depth feel worn-in rather than theatrical.

signals.note: Berry-purple lips identified among fall-winter directions
ABH Kiss Theory spans cranberry through burgundy
Deep-berry Gloss Bomb Burst launch shades

makeup.action_direction: Blurred berry stain plus deep-berry gloss
makeup.action: Develop one soft-matte stain for worn-in depth and one shine-first gloss with the same cool undertone. Use fruit-led shade names to communicate color depth before swatching.

makeup.name: Soft-Matte Base and Lived-In Smoke
makeup.summary: Texture is becoming more important than coverage.
makeup.description: Complexion is settling between flat matte and glass skin, while cool brown and grey-mauve eye color is washed across the socket with deliberately softened edges.

signals.note: Soft-focus complexion ranked first among fall-winter looks
Pocket Bronze pairs cream texture with eight-hour wear
Chocolate Soleil reinforces matte cocoa sculpting

makeup.action: Prioritize cream-to-powder sticks, finger-blendable bronzer and one-swipe cream shadow that diffuse light while preserving natural skin texture.

makeup.name: Liquid Blush 2.0
makeup.summary: Cheek competition is shifting from shade stories to format mechanics.
makeup.description: Oversized doe-foot liquids, cream-over-powder compacts and portable sticks all promise buildable color without patchiness, making applicator and texture the primary differentiation.

signals.note: Insatiable Liquid Blush pairs range breadth with 16-hour wear
Patrick Ta cream-and-powder blush duo
Liquid blush price benchmark

makeup.action: Design an applicator that controls the first deposit and a texture that can be tapped out with fingers. Treat a broad, skin-tone-aware shade range as a core shelf signal.

makeup.name: Fall Gourmand Crosses Into Makeup
makeup.summary: Dessert language is moving from fragrance into color cosmetics.
makeup.description: Caramel, milk, cocoa and warm spice now name lip, cheek and complexion products, using scent-led language to communicate color temperature and comfort.

signals.note: Sunlit Vanilla links gourmand language with long wear
Honey lip-oil set spans caramel hazelnut and dark cherry
Chocolate Soleil joins shade and sensorial cues

makeup.action: Use caramel, praline, gingerbread and hot-milk language across lip, bronzer, mask and fragrance so one seasonal story can support several categories.

makeup.name: One-Stroke Formats
makeup.summary: New launches compete on how little technique they require.
makeup.description: Multi-function tools, intuitive shade names and curated sets reduce the number of decisions between opening a product and completing a look.

signals.note: Eye pen combines lining, filling and blending
Drink-inspired names simplify velvet-matte lip choice
Eye, cheek and lip products form one autumn look

makeup.action_direction: Fewest steps to a finished face
makeup.action: Focus NPD briefs on multi-use tools, self-explanatory shade systems and curated sets that remove brushes, color-description work and pairing decisions.

makeup.name: Eastern Botanical Palette
makeup.summary: Botanical color language and skincare-infused base are shaping the China autumn look.
makeup.description: Botanical brown, bright moss green and milk-satin finishes create a soft, low-contrast face, while cushions add skincare claims so glow reads as skin quality rather than surface shine.

signals.note: Timage autumn botanical limited collection
Milk Skin Cushion 2.0 combines wear and dewy comfort
Botanical color and makeup-skincare hybrid cycle

makeup.action: Pair a distinctly local botanical palette with a treatment-led cushion. The combination supports premiumization while keeping the application gesture simple and familiar.

makeup.name: Double 11 Early Window
makeup.summary: Base makeup and refill bundles are carrying the color-cosmetics basket.
makeup.description: During the opening window, facial makeup took a disproportionate share of category sales, with cushion, foundation and powder bundles lifting repeat purchase and basket size.

signals.note: Facial makeup share in the Douyin opening window
Color cosmetics and fragrance GMV across four days
Livestreams exceeding RMB 10M GMV

makeup.action_direction: Cushion plus refill as the Q4 hero format
makeup.action: Lead with cushion-and-refill and full-size-plus-refill bundles, supported by livestream-exclusive specifications, clear restock windows and creator content built around repeat purchase.

fragrance.name: Warm Gourmand 2.0
fragrance.summary: Spice, milk and caramel are moving gourmand beyond simple sugar.
fragrance.description: Toasted nuts, warm milk and spice are wrapping around vanilla and caramel, creating comfort and slow development in cold weather rather than confectionery sweetness.

signals.note: Gourmand popularity index
Le Monde Gourmand Pumpkin Creme price point
Sunlit Vanilla claims eight-hour wear

fragrance.action_direction: Warm gourmand with texture and restraint
fragrance.action: Prototype a toasted-spice route and a warm-milk route, controlling sweetness and proving wear so the concept reads as comfort rather than novelty.

fragrance.name: Holiday Collectibles
fragrance.summary: Fragrance is becoming a giftable object rather than a refill.
fragrance.description: Limited editions, ornament-packed solids and sculptural bottles with reusable tops turn scent into something to display, collect and hand over.

signals.note: Cang Qiu EDP with separate gift and diffuser formats
Valentino Ruby limited drop
St. Barts solid fragrance in ornament packaging

fragrance.action_direction: Collectible vessel plus accessible companion format
fragrance.action: Pair a display-worthy hero bottle with a lower-ticket solid, mini or ornament format, keeping the visual code reusable beyond one holiday window.

fragrance.name: Extrait as a Premium Signal
fragrance.summary: Concentration is replacing EDP shorthand as proof of quality.
fragrance.description: High-oil extraits, vessel ageing and eight-hour-plus wear claims are becoming headline specifications that make premium value easier to understand.

signals.note: Saint Petal concentration benchmark
Saint Petal longevity range
Allegra Baciami Ancora premium benchmark

fragrance.action: Use concentration, maturation and verified wear as front-of-pack proof points, then support them with a clear sensorial reason for the richer format.

fragrance.name: Retailer Exclusives as the Launch Format
fragrance.summary: Exclusive retail windows are becoming the launch event itself.
fragrance.description: Limited runs and early-access drops concentrate discovery into a single channel before broader rollout, simplifying the first media and sampling moment.

signals.note: OUAI St. Barts Solid exclusive drop
Born in Roma Ruby first-launch window
Fragrance share of Sephora sales

fragrance.action_direction: Stage discovery through a controlled early-access window
fragrance.action: Use one retailer for the initial sampling, review and scarcity cycle, with a defined national-rollout date and channel-specific pack or size.

fragrance.name: Domestic Beauty Majors Enter Fragrance
fragrance.summary: Chinese beauty groups are using fragrance as a second growth category.
fragrance.description: Established beauty companies are porting familiar ingredients, narratives and customer relationships into eau de parfum instead of starting from an unknown scent identity.

signals.note: Roopy Dreamland full sizes and minis
Fragrance growth versus 8.4% for makeup
China fragrance penetration versus 40%+ in Western markets

fragrance.action_direction: Extend an owned beauty code into scent
fragrance.action: Start with a brand ingredient, color or emotional code customers already recognize, then launch coordinated full-size and discovery formats to lower trial friction.

fragrance.name: Eastern Terroir Notes
fragrance.summary: Place-based Eastern notes are replacing generic pyramids with landscape stories.
fragrance.description: Fermented tea, bamboo, cool sandalwood, moss and camphor wood create narratives that shift on skin and feel rooted in a specific place rather than a generic top-heart-base structure.

signals.note: Reads for the Each Their Scent topic
Plays for the corresponding challenge
Half-year growth in fragrance-note content

fragrance.action_direction: Build scent around a precise landscape
fragrance.action: Choose one place, material and season, then connect the note architecture, naming, imagery and discovery copy to that same landscape.

fragrance.name: International Niche Retreats in China
fragrance.summary: Prestige niche distribution is contracting as domestic premium brands gain space.
fragrance.description: Selected international houses are leaving flagship malls while local fragrance brands expand, reflecting a sharper reassessment of imported price premiums and channel productivity.

signals.note: Operating period before one Nanjing flagship closure
Recent exits across Jinan and Shanghai
Imported niche 50ml benchmark

fragrance.action_direction: Prove premium value beyond imported provenance
fragrance.action: Audit store productivity, sampling conversion and repeat purchase by city. Strengthen product proof and local relevance before expanding premium doors.
